description: Native S7.5 v2 append-only asset master versions. Existing S7 canonical fields remain explicit while version lineage and the exact incremental aggregate-state digest are added.

qa_rules.description: Every asset_master_version_id must reproduce from the exact stable key, predecessor, availability and canonical aggregate payload.
A mechanical successor cannot move first-seen lineage, counts, distinct-value sets or evidence availability backward.
